name: Nexus Transfer
summary:
Transfer photos, videos, documents, folders, and other files directly between devices without uploading them to the cloud. Nexus Transfer works across Android, Windows, and Quest, making it easy to share files between your devices. It is designed for local, offline-first sharing, so your files stay on your own network.


FEATURES

• Send or receive files and folders over your local Wi-Fi network
• Transfer multiple files and folders at once
